- `package.json`, `package-lock.json` (added exact `@testing-library/user-event@14.6.1` for real keyboard simulation)

**Verification**
- `npm test -- tests/components/primitives.test.tsx tests/styles/tokens.test.ts` — 66/66 passing
- `npm test` — 98/98 passing
- `npm run typecheck` — passing
- `npm run lint` — passing
- `npm run format:check` — passing
- `npm run build` — passing

**Evidence summary**
- Keyboard/focus: Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside Dialog; Escape closes; close-button close restores focus; initial focus lands on the first input rather than the close control; Enter/Space activate Button, IconButton, Toast action, and EmptyState action; Field control is tab-reachable.
- Targets: parsed CSS resolves `--target-min` to 44 px and asserts ≥44×44 for Button, IconButton, Dialog controls, Toast action, Field control, and EmptyState action.
- Contrast: computed token pairs cover body, muted, paper, link, error text (≥4.5:1), primary/danger/success/warning controls (≥4.5:1), large headings (≥3:1), and focus/border non-text pairs (≥3:1).
- Motion: parsed reduced-motion block removes primitive transitions, animations, and transforms.
- Palette isolation: component TSX/CSS contains no raw hex/rgb/hsl values and no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.
- No browser viewport matrix was run; this task's validation scope is unit/component and token-contract tests.

**Handoff notes**
- `AppShell.css` now consumes tokens; preserve `.app-frame*`, `.placeholder*`, `.not-found*`, and `.error-view*` selectors and the focus/inert behavior.
- `Toast` should remain mounted with `message={null}` between announcements so the polite live region persists.
- Direction B is the approved theme; tokens.css is the sole palette source.

handoff.summary: Implemented locked Midnight Archive tokens, base styles, Button/IconButton/Dialog/Toast/Field/EmptyState primitives, token contrast and keyboard/focus test suites; all required tests, typecheck, and lint pass.
decisions: Applied Direction B (Midnight Archive) as the single dark theme with period headings limited to headings and case-file chrome.
Used a render-prop Field API so input/textarea/select keeps correct label, hint, and error wiring without duplicating ID logic.
Kept Toast timers in feature owners while the primitive always renders a polite live region and optional keyboard-operable action.
interfaces: Dialog: open, onClose, title, description, children, actions, size, dismissible, closeOnBackdrop, initialFocusRef, returnFocusRef.
Toast: message (nullable to keep the live region mounted), tone, actionLabel/onAction, onDismiss.
Field: label, hint, error, required and a render-prop control props object.
